analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read in Type_MLU_Write: it iterates i < mlu->UsedEntries and reads mlu->Entries[i], but the cmsMLU object can have fewer allocated entries than UsedEntries. In this PoV, a malformed profile causes inconsistent internal tag data (via prior tag parsing, including cmsSigGamutTag/LUT handling), and during save (SaveTags -> WritePtr -> Type_MLU_Write) the writer trusts UsedEntries without validating against allocated capacity, leading to read past the Entries array.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: cms_profile_fuzzer opens attacker ICC bytes, calls cmsReadTag(hProfile, cmsSigGamutTag), then cmsSaveProfileToFile. The crafted profile must create/retain a corrupted cmsMLU state where UsedEntries is larger than the actual allocated entry count (or otherwise inconsistent with Entries backing storage). On save, SaveTags dispatches to MLU writer, which loops over UsedEntries and dereferences out-of-bounds mlu->Entries, triggering ASan heap-buffer-overflow read.
